ayahs.1: Qasam hai anjeer ki aur zaitoon ki.
ayahs.3: Aur is amn wale shehar ki.
ayahs.4: Yaqeenan hum ne insaan ko behtareen soorat mein paida kiya.
ayahs.5: Phir use neechon se neecha kar diya.
ayahs.6: Lekin jo log imaan laaye aur (phir) nek amal kiye to un ke liye aisa ajr hai jo kabhi khatm na hoga.
ayahs.7: Pas tujhe ab roz-e-jaza ke jhutlaane par kaun si cheez aamaada karti hai.
ayahs.8: Kya Allah Taala (sab) haakimon ka haakim nahin hai.
